messages.author: d17553208d13f6a8
messages.subject: Fragmentation metrics
parts:
Hi all,

Has anyone had any success generating fragmentation metrics in part 5?

I added  
frag.metrics="all",
 part5_agg2_60seconds=TRUE,

to the shell script part 5 section but I can't get any fragmentation variables in the part 5 report using a test file that runs through ok otherwise.

Any advice on where I might be going wrong would be great!
 thanks

messages.author: 5270e62a7d3ec577
messages.subject: RE: [GGIR] Fragmentation metrics
parts:
Hi Stuart,

 

The below parameters worked for me using v2.5.0, might help in looking for discrepancies? Without knowing your full input parameters I would suggest checking the inactivity parameters first:

 

windowsizes = c(5,900,3600), #5 s epoch, 15 min non-wear detection resolution, 60 min non-wear evaluation window

do.cal=TRUE,

do.enmo = TRUE,

do.anglez=TRUE,

do.angle=TRUE,

doangley=TRUE,

chunksize=1,

printsummary=TRUE,

#-------------------------------

# Part 2 parameters:

#-------------------------------

strategy = 1,

ndayswindow=7,

hrs.del.start = 0,

hrs.del.end = 0,

maxdur = 9,

includedaycrit = 16,

M5L5res = 10,

winhr = c(c(960/60),c(600/60),c(480/60),c(300/60)),

M5L5 = c(0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9),

iglevels = TRUE,

qlevels = c(c(1320/1440),c(1380/1440),c(1410/1440),c(1425/1440),c(1430/1440),c(1435/1440),c(1438/1440),c(1439/1440)),

qwindow=c(0,24),

ilevels = c(0,40,100,400,8000),

mvpathreshold =c(40,100,400),

boutcriter = c(0.8),

mvpadur = c(1,5,10),

bout.metric = 4,

closedbout = FALSE,

#-------------------------------

# Part 3 parameters:

#-------------------------------

timethreshold= c(5),

anglethreshold=5,

ignorenonwear = TRUE,

#-------------------------------

# Part 4 parameters:

#-------------------------------

excludefirstlast = FALSE,

includenightcrit = 16,

def.noc.sleep = c(1),

outliers.only = FALSE,

criterror = 4,

relyonsleeplog = FALSE,

sleeplogidnum = FALSE,

colid=1,

coln1=2,

do.visual = TRUE,

nnights = 7,

#-------------------------------

# Part 5 parameters:

#-------------------------------

# Key functions: Merging physical activity with sleep analyses

threshold.lig = c(40),

threshold.mod = c(100),

threshold.vig = c(400),

boutcriter = 0.8,

boutcriter.in = 0.9,

boutcriter.lig = 0.8,

boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8,

boutdur.in = c(10,20,30,60,120,180,240),

boutdur.lig = c(10,30,60),

boutdur.mvpa = c(1,2,5,10),

timewindow = c("MM","WW"),

frag.metrics="all",

part5_agg2_60seconds=TRUE,

#-----------------------------------

# Report generation

#-------------------------------

do.report=c(2,4,5),

visualreport=TRUE,

dofirstpage = TRUE,

epochvalues2csv=TRUE,

viewingwindow=1)

From: rpacka...@googlegroups.com <rpacka...@googlegroups.com> On Behalf Of Stuart F
Sent: 17-11-2021 02:45
To: R package GGIR <Rpacka...@googlegroups.com>
Subject: [GGIR] Fragmentation metrics

 

Hi all,

 

Has anyone had any success generating fragmentation metrics in part 5?

 

I added  

frag.metrics="all",

 part5_agg2_60seconds=TRUE,

 

to the shell script part 5 section but I can't get any fragmentation variables in the part 5 report using a test file that runs through ok otherwise.

 

Any advice on where I might be going wrong would be great!

 thanks

--

messages.author: 5270e62a7d3ec577
messages.subject: RE: [GGIR] Fragmentation metrics
parts:
Hi Stuart, good to hear it’s working – These new metrics look really interesting and it’s great that they are now accessible through GGIR instead of calculating externally.

 

Regarding winhr – these are the MX continuous metrics – 960/60 representing the most active continuous 16hrs etc. Can use this for timings and also acceleration values.

 

Kind regards,

Ben
